title: CodexTechLeadDecisions
description: Output schema for the tech-lead axis in Stage 2 of Codex PR review v2. The tech-lead reviews every finding from combined.json and decides whether to allow it as a PR comment. Post-script applies hard rules afterward (MUST + security + domain-critical findings are forced to allow=true regardless of this decision).

id.description: Must match a finding id from combined.json.

allow.description: true to post the comment, false to suppress. Hard rules in post-script can override false → true (never the reverse) for MUST / security / domain-critical findings.

reason.description: Short rationale in Korean (e.g. 'false positive: 해당 규칙은 이 파일에 적용 안 됨').

judgment.description: Optional. Tech-lead's qualitative judgment on the PR as a whole. Post-script uses this for the LGTM line. Hard rule still wins: any MUST forces 要対応.

merge_notes.description: Optional. Used when the tech-lead consolidates duplicate findings across axes. Keep primary, deny merged ids.
